messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the video's camera setup to a full-body shot from a front three-quarter angle. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Retain the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action in the same environment. Only change how the camera captures the scene. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Please return to video 0 and make the following change to that video: Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change the video's camera setup to a full-body shot from a front three-quarter angle. Retain the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action in the same environment. Only change how the camera captures the scene. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"He stands on an asphalt road, shifting his weight and taking small steps while looking around.","camera":"Full-body shot from a low angle, with the camera remaining mostly static.","clothing":"White sleeveless tank top with a pink and purple graphic print, pink shorts with white trim, and red sneakers.","hair_color":"Platinum blonde.","hairstyle":"Short, cropped hair.","identity":"A slim, dark-skinned young man with a short beard and mustache.","scene":"An outdoor paved area under a concrete overpass, with a metal railing, green foliage, and a construction crane visible in the background under a partly cloudy sky."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output changes from a close side profile to a full-body front three-quarter view. The subject is now shown from head to toe, standing on the road with an overpass, railing, foliage, and crane visible behind him. His white hair, white graphic tank top, pink shorts, and red shoes remain visible, and he continues small weight shifts and steps while looking around.
arguments.requested_change: Change the camera to a full-body shot from a front three-quarter angle, using the reference for initial viewing direction, subject placement, and framing, while preserving the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, action, environment, timing, and progression.
uncertain: Whether the exact initial subject placement and framing match the reference image precisely.
unexpected_changes: The environment now includes a prominent concrete overpass and construction crane that were not visible in the source close-up, though this may be due to the wider camera framing.
